interpretation.next_physical_target: Inspect actual C/D retimed-input routing, termination and common-mode delivery. At the worst early event the upstream HBT70 emitter is 1.27613 V, gain HBT60 base is 1.13496 V and termination-resistor188 input is 1.01134 V on one native net. A physical repair must be selected with native route/RC topology, not by changing test thresholds.
interpretation.scope_limit: This identifies real active stress and distributed local voltage differences. It does not yet isolate the complete resistance/capacitance contribution, supply a passing circuit repair, or establish full-loop/PHY acceptance.
